home.headline: A modern modular CMS with an old-school spirit.
home.description: NovaNuke is running with modular content, themes, blocks, menus and secure user accounts.
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.login.heading: Welcome back.
auth.login.description: Sign in with your NovaNuke username or email.
auth.register.title: Create account
auth.register.heading: Create your account.
auth.register.verification_required: You will need to verify your email before signing in.
auth.register.active_immediately: Your account will be active immediately.
auth.verification.resend_help: Enter the address used during registration. If a pending account exists, NovaNuke will send a new link.
auth.verification.resend_sent: If a pending account exists for that address, a new verification link has been sent.
account.profile.title: Profile and preferences
account.avatar.title: Avatar
account.avatar.help: JPEG, PNG or WebP; 2 MB maximum; 32–2048 pixels.
account.password.title: Change password
account.password.changed: Password changed successfully. Sign in again.
account.security.title: Account security
account.security.description: Review recent successful sign-ins and manage the lifecycle of your account.
account.delete.title: Delete account
account.delete.warning: This permanently anonymizes your identity and removes credentials, profile data, avatar, roles and access history. Published content remains under a non-personal former-user identity. This action cannot be undone.
account.deleted.title: Account deleted
account.deleted.message: Your account and personal profile data were anonymized. You have been signed out.
account.email.title: Change email address
account.email.help: Your current address remains active until you confirm the one-time link sent to the new address.
account.email.sent: Confirmation sent. Check the new address; the link expires in 60 minutes.
account.email.changed: Your new email address is verified. Existing sessions were closed; sign in again with the new address.
account.email.invalid: This link is invalid, expired, already used, or the address is no longer available.
profile.private: This profile is visible to registered members only.
settings.title: General settings
settings.description: Public site preferences are stored here. Database, mail and cryptographic credentials remain in .env.
settings.maintenance_help: Visitors receive a temporary 503 response. Administrative routes and signed-in Super Administrators remain available.
